summary: Iteration 2 — Validated P0/P1/P2 features + Aarambh design refresh. Backend: 49 passed, 1 xfail (documenting a real bug). Frontend: dashboard layout, sidebar (244px ink-900), Inter font, breadcrumbs '·', ⌘K hint, Export Excel button, 6 stat tiles, SLA 'Today' pill all verified. Reviewer NotificationsBell + panel shows the new-vendor-submitted notifications end-to-end.

minor.issue: SapPushIn model is MISSING the account_group field_validator. Only company_code is whitelisted; invalid account_group like 'BADGRP' returns 200 OK and persists a bogus mapping. SapMappingIn has both validators — copy the _ag validator (lines 317-322 of server.py) onto SapPushIn (after the existing _cc validator near line 974).

Public ingress only routes /api/*, so https://<host>/health serves the React index.html. The endpoint works internally on :8001 (verified) so k8s liveness probes are fine — but if the probe is configured against the external URL it will succeed for the wrong reason. Recommend probe hits http://localhost:8001/health (or move /health under /api).

Cloudflare edge intercepts preflight and returns 204 with 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' for ALL origins (including https://attacker.example.com). The backend allow_origin_regex never gets a chance to filter. Behaviorally the actual POST request still has its Origin checked by the browser, so this is low-risk, but the regex is effectively a no-op on the public URL. Verified via localhost:8001 that the regex itself works correctly (200 for emergent origin, 400 for attacker).

sap_push() does the 'company_code already mapped' check AFTER the mock BAPI call succeeds, leaving an orphaned outbox 'done' entry for a never-persisted mapping. Move the duplicate check to before _mock_bapi_vendor_create().

rca of the issue: Missing account_group validator on SapPushIn — root cause is that during the P0 work, the company_code validator was correctly added to SapPushIn but the account_group validator (which exists on the older SapMappingIn schema) was not copied over. Reproduction: POST /api/vendors/{approved_id}/sap-push with body {company_code:'1000', account_group:'BADGRP', payment_terms:'NT30'} as sap_team — currently returns 200 with a bogus account_group persisted. Mitigation: add `@field_validator('account_group')` classmethod to SapPushIn returning v.upper() if v in ALLOWED_ACCT_GROUPS else raise.
